title: Evidence-Grounded Content Generation Boundary
status: governance-defined; Layer 1 approved; implementation blocked pending policy packs
scope: approved Product, Offer, Audience, Positioning, Strategy and Customer Segment evidence authority
one logical versioned tenant-and-brand Voice authority
deterministic anti-generic and evidence-bound factuality validation
Campaign Asset-owned draft, review, approval, rejection and supersession lifecycle
versioned policy-pack governance without implementation authority
layer_1_invariants: immutable tenant-and-brand-bound grounding snapshot with deterministic versioned serialization and source IDs, versions and digests
approved Product, Offer, Audience, Positioning, Strategy and Customer Segment evidence remains owned by existing domains
provider output never authorizes claims, approval or workflow transitions
high-risk unsupported, stale, revoked, conflicting and cross-tenant claims are blocked
unknown and low-confidence claims are review_required and cannot be approved until resolved or explicitly revalidated
exact replay is distinct from regeneration
bounded generation and asset lifecycle with immutable rejection and supersession
Campaign Asset remains lifecycle owner and operation claims own only coordination, replay and recovery
missing and cross-tenant resources return indistinguishable safe responses
no execution, publishing, spend, learning, deployment or release authority
approved_defaults: one logical versioned tenant-and-brand Voice authority; existing VoiceProfile may adapt but is not a parallel authority
new raw grounding content is not persisted before retention, deletion, privacy and ownership policy approval
destructive deletion remains disabled until retention and legal-hold policy is approved
existing platform encryption and security controls are reused without a new encryption commitment
machine-readable error codes remain internal and provider-neutral until public compatibility is approved
existing Campaign Asset persistence is inspected first; a generation-attempt record requires separate authorization

policy_packs.name: golden_corpus
policy_packs.rollback: restore prior corpus and rule pairing

deferred_founder_decisions: factuality confidence and high-risk claim policy
retention, archival, deletion and legal-hold policy
storage fields, migration details and encryption implementation details
out_of_scope: execution, publishing, providers, spend, learning, deployment, release, cloud, SOC 2 tooling, customer activation and parallel evidence or asset storage
